posts.title: Scott Joplin: Genius of Classic Ragtime and Architect of American Music
posts.description: Scott Joplin stands as one of the most transformative figures in American cultural history. Drawing on African-American musical traditions and European musical forms, Joplin helped establish classic ragtime as a distinctive and enduring compositional art, bringing extraordinary rhythmic vitality, formal balance, and expressive depth to the genre. posts.title: Dusé Mohamed Ali: A Life Across Continents, a Vision of African Freedom
posts.description: Dusé Mohamed Ali was an actor, playwright, historian, journalist, publisher, and political organizer whose career connected Africa, Europe, the Caribbean, and the United States. Across these overlapping worlds, he pursued a lasting purpose: to strengthen African and Asian peoples’ ability to represent themselves, defend their interests, and build relationships beyond European colonial structures.
